entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jørgen Vig Knudstorp is a Danish businessman who is the Chairman of the Foundation and Supervisory Boards at IMD Business School since 1 January 2026. He currently serves as Deputy chair of the LEGO Foundation and chair of BrainPOP Education Inc. He is also lead independent director of Starbucks Corporation and a member of Nike's board of directors.
